torch_compile.interpretation: Transformers enabled compilation because backend and mode were supplied even though the CLI compile flag was absent. Eight selected-row shapes recompiled before Dynamo fell back to eager execution. Hot steps after fallback are valid eager throughput evidence; the early compiled timings are not.

heldout_evaluation.interpretation: The old streaming iterable reconstructed to a different effective set and only 16 reported examples. These values are historical logs, not fixed held-out quality evidence.
